tasks.short: Study appeals procedures for legal compliance

steps.what: Scope the appeals study and select authoritative procedure documents
Compare appeals procedures with cited legal requirements

loop.purpose: Draft a sourced comparison of procedure clauses and requirements
loop.input: Selected procedure versions, jurisdiction, effective dates and authoritative passages
loop.output: Comparison table with exact passages, gaps and uncertainty labels
loop.check: Mediator checks meaning, exceptions, currency and whether each cited requirement actually applies
loop.stop: Two failed comparisons, missing sources or conflicting requirements return the comparison to manual study
loop.why_not_simpler: Textual procedural differences cannot be resolved by matching article numbers alone

steps.what: Conclude whether procedures comply and recommend justified changes

tasks.design: Test native search and side-by-side document comparison in {DOCS} first. A bounded model drafts a passage-linked comparison from selected sources; the mediator verifies applicability and authors the findings without automatically changing a procedure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant requirements and procedural clauses use different language.
tasks.enabler_now: Document review tools can draft comparisons with supporting source passages.
tasks.still_hard: Legal interpretation and choosing changes that preserve procedural fairness.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a formally compliant procedure that disadvantages a party.
tasks.altitude: Some comparison effort moves to testing the consequences of recommended changes.

evidence.claim: Legora supports tabular review of document sets; this does not establish accurate appeals compliance decisions.
Comparison savings and continuing legal judgement are unmeasured design assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary is an internal study ending with findings; adopting procedures and deciding individual appeals are excluded.

Mediator produces study scope, jurisdiction, procedure version, effective date, document identifier and selected legal source passages in s1's 30 hours. Missing or conflicting source metadata triggers manual source checking before s2; no inferred requirement becomes a compliance finding.
Native document comparison is tested before custom code. Existing search runtime earns no labour saving.
The proposed table is advisory and never changes a procedure or determines an appeal.
unknowns: Procedure versions and authoritative source access
Applicable restrictions on assisted ADR work
research_questions: Does source-verified comparison reduce total study effort without missing exceptions?

already_counted.description: Check comparison meaning and complete difficult comparisons manually

incremental.description: Maintain comparison tests and source access controls

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+24+30=84, gross=16, upkeep=5, net=11. Range 0-6 allows conflicting procedures and lengthy legal verification.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Negotiate environmental conflicts and work toward a mutually acceptable resolution

tasks.design: Keep environmental conflict negotiation with the mediator and participating parties. Evidence remains available in {DOCS}, but this task's relationship work and negotiated trade-offs have no demonstrated removable component.
tasks.previous_blocker: Conflicts involve competing values and unequal power rather than a missing calculation.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated technical change replaces consent-building.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling resource allocation, development goals and long-term environmental impacts.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise withheld concerns and protect a fair dialogue.
tasks.altitude: The mediator's negotiating role remains unchanged.

reach.learn: Environmental evidence and participatory process design

evidence.claim: Environmental conflict negotiation depends on consent and contextual judgement; no task-level saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary covers live negotiation and resolution work; research, scheduling and formal documentation belong to their narrower tasks and are not duplicated here.
No structured input or automated action is introduced. Mediator supports dialogue and cannot bind parties without their own consent.
Native document access remains available; no new system is built.
Zero incremental upkeep because the proposed workflow does not change.
research_questions: Which preparation activity, if any, is separately measurable without reducing negotiation time?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. The negotiation itself remains fully human.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Organize and deliver public mediation presentations

steps.what: Organize presentation arrangements and establish the audience's mediation questions
Prepare presentations and examples explaining mediation to the audience

loop.purpose: Adapt approved public material to the audience's questions
loop.input: Presentation brief and approved public explanations
loop.output: Draft slides and speaking notes with source references
loop.check: Mediator checks accuracy, neutrality, comprehensibility and that examples disclose no case information
loop.stop: After one unsatisfactory revision or an unsupported legal claim, mediator uses existing materials manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates arrange slides but do not adapt explanations to varied audiences

steps.what: Check and deliver public presentations and answer audience questions

tasks.design: Reuse approved material through native templates in {DOCS} first. Where adaptation still takes time, a bounded draft step proposes explanations; the mediator checks the final presentation and delivers it personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Audience-specific explanations take preparation even when the principles repeat.
tasks.enabler_now: A constrained drafting tool can suggest simpler explanations from approved material.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to sensitive personal questions without turning public education into case advice.
tasks.human_edge: Read the audience and explain difficult choices with neutrality.
tasks.altitude: A small amount of preparation time returns to audience engagement.

evidence.claim: Constrained presentation drafting may reduce some adaptation work; the small net saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary includes arranging, preparing and delivering public presentations; confidential case preparation is excluded.

Mediator captures audience, purpose, duration, accessibility needs, approved source versions and forbidden confidential topics in s1's 20 hours. Missing information leads to ordinary host correspondence; unsupported examples are omitted rather than invented.
Native templates and existing presentation reuse are tested before a model step and are not counted as new savings.
The final presentation remains under the mediator's control; no automated publishing occurs.
research_questions: Does audience adaptation save more than its recurring review and upkeep cost?

incremental.description: Refresh public sources and review drafting failures

approvals.approved_version: Exact final slide and speaking-note version including examples and source references; changes require renewed review before delivery

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=20+20+55=95, gross=5, upkeep=3, net=2. Range 0-1 allows low frequency and extensive audience-specific review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Participate in court proceedings and respond within the authorised role

tasks.design: Keep participation in proceedings with the authorised person. Case materials in {DOCS} support attendance, but no software replacement or reduction of the live participation time is claimed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Participation requires personal accountability and immediate contextual responses.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated change removes the required human participation.
tasks.still_hard: Protecting confidentiality while responding properly to court directions.
tasks.human_edge: Understand questions and exercise professional restraint in real time.

evidence.claim: Live court participation remains human work; no removable clerical baseline is established by this task.

assumptions: Boundary is live court participation only. Research, scheduling and document preparation are allocated to their respective tasks.
No automated action or new structured data contract is introduced. Participation is only within the individual's lawful and permitted role.
Existing document access may continue without custom code or claimed saving.
Zero incremental upkeep because no workflow change is proposed.
unknowns: Permitted role and confidentiality obligations in particular proceedings
research_questions: Is any separately measured preparation activity consuming avoidable time outside participation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, upkeep=0, net=0. Personal participation is retained in full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Legal conclusions, environmental negotiation and court participation remain personal; selected comparison and presentation preparation gain modest assistance.
reach: Adapt public mediation information for community audiences
role.ambitious_version: A mediator with more time to explain choices and test procedural fairness while retaining personal responsibility.
